{{Nihongo|Dr. '''Shisanji Hokari'''|穂刈 四三二|Hokari Shisanji|28 March 1908 – 2 January 2004}} was a Japanese [[mathematician]]. He was admitted to the [[American Mathematical Society]] in 1966.<ref>Green, John W.; Sherman, Seymour. The annual meeting in Chicago. Bull. Amer. Math. Soc. 72 (1966), no. 3, p. 476 https://projecteuclid.org/euclid.bams/1183527951.</ref> He was a professor emeritus of [[Tokyo Metropolitan University]] and the president of [[Josai University]].
